summary: Refresh population metrics reactively and preserve canonical repository and stale-host membership evidence

replay.detail: No replay or backfill is required.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or claim changes.

rules.detail: Runtime and attention source authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Population refreshes follow store notifications and due classification deadlines with a minimum rest, rather than polling unchanged stores. Non-authoritative host loss preserves last-live members. Canonical repository identities are normalized from positively recognized checkout paths within the population fold. Ordinary roster reads do not load population repository evidence. Excess population attribute sets use the SDK overflow stream instead of freezing snapshot publication.

manual.detail: Existing deployment-owned repository configuration and rollout gates remain applicable.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback; durable state is unchanged.
